heroHeadline: Zelensky Open Letter Challenges Putin to Face-to-Face Talks; Ukraine Strikes Kronstadt Naval Base (Corvette Ablaze) + St. Petersburg Oil Terminal — Day 1,562
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,562 of Russia's full-scale invasion, President Zelensky published an open letter to Putin proposing a direct face-to-face meeting in a neutral country — Switzerland, Turkey, or the Arab world — with a full ceasefire for the duration of talks and EU leaders present. Putin responded by rejecting EU participation, demanding Ukraine withdraw from Donetsk Oblast, and calling a ceasefire 'unacceptable.' Trump called a potential meeting 'great.' The diplomatic exchange came two days after Ukraine struck Kronstadt naval base near St. Petersburg (June 3, Day 1,560) — setting the guided-missile corvette Boikiy ablaze in dry dock — and simultaneously struck St. Petersburg's oil terminal and a Tambov defense facility in Ukraine's deepest naval strike of the war. The SPIEF ('Putin's Davos') was opening as drones flew over Russia's second city. On June 4, Russia continued attacking Ukrainian territory: 924 strikes across 52 Zaporizhzhia Oblast settlements, drone attacks on two Kharkiv districts setting a residential building ablaze, and 50+ attacks on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast (1 killed). Russian cumulative losses reached ~1,369,340 — advancing at ~1,300 per day — while ISW confirmed Russia's spring-summer 2026 offensive has largely stalled at 2.9 sq km/day. Ukraine's 2026 drone energy campaign has now struck 19+ Russian energy facilities, costing Russia $10.5B+ in losses and reducing refinery capacity ~40%.
